info.title: GRP coordination candidate — draft
info.description: Unreleased, non-normative review artifact. Not merged into the published base contract or live conformance verdict. Schemas constrain canonical client forms, not every ignored legacy field. State-dependent authority, Unicode/UTF-8 limits and cryptographic checks also require implementation tests.

x-grp-remaining-gates: speaking-turn read/wait integration and exhaustive cross-field/error semantics

post.description: Participant-token only. Request, renew or release one speaking request. Fresh request IDs require a 13-digit Unix-millisecond prefix, underscore and 36 lowercase hex/hyphen characters; server checks retry age. Held renew/release requires the current epoch; queued operations need no epoch. No observation is issued. Reconciliation may commit even on denial.

ParticipantToken.description: Credential scoped to participant and room. Shared-resource/turn/composing mutations reject X-Mandate. Working-signal operations additionally support the separate Mandate form. Reads use room visibility policy; bearer security shown here is a supported read form, not a requirement on every public room.

Mandate.name: X-Mandate
Mandate.description: Verified mandate envelope; only the three working-signal operations in this draft accept it, requiring react scope and an existing joined seat. Not equivalent action/artifact/turn support.

ReviewPresentation.description: Viewer-relative presentation of the latest requested round, not necessarily the artifact's newest draft. Base is the latest earlier round reviewed by this viewer. Diff is navigation, not approval or a complete text patch; retrieve exact content by revision ID.

HistoricalReview.description: Later correction notes do not replace the recorded disposition or rewrite settled outcomes.
